en.headline: Siobhan Haughey defends Asian Games 200m freestyle title
en.dek: The Hong Kong swimmer clocked 1:54.96 to retain gold in Nagoya, while Ian Ho took silver in the men's 50m freestyle.
body: Siobhan Haughey retained her Asian Games women's 200 metres freestyle title on Monday, touching in 1 minute 54.96 seconds at the Tokyo Aquatics Centre in Nagoya.

The Olympic medallist controlled the final from the start and claimed Hong Kong's first swimming gold of the Games. China's Li Jiaping took silver and Liu Yaxin bronze. Haughey's teammate Gilaine Ma finished fifth.
Haughey had also won the event at the previous Asian Games in Hangzhou. Combined with Sunday's silver in the women's 4x100 metres freestyle relay, she now holds one gold and one silver in Nagoya.

Ian Ho added a silver medal in the men's 50 metres freestyle, clocking 21.76 seconds. He finished just behind South Korea's Kim Youngbeom, who set a Games record. Hong Kong now has three swimming medals at these Games.

zh.headline: 何詩蓓成功衛冕亞運200米自由泳金牌
zh.dek: 港將以1分54秒96衛冕女子200米自由泳金牌，何甄陶則奪男子50米自由泳銀牌。
body: 何詩蓓星期一於名古屋東京水上運動中心以1分54秒96成功衛冕亞運女子200米自由泳金牌，為港隊奪得本屆亞運首面游泳金牌。
這位奧運獎牌得主由始至終領先，中國選手李佳萍及劉亞欣分奪銀銅牌，隊友馬樂怡名列第五。
何詩蓓在上屆杭州亞運亦奪得同一項目金牌。連同星期日女子4x100米自由泳接力銀牌，她本屆已獲一金一銀。
何甄陶在男子50米自由泳以21秒76奪銀，僅次於破亞運紀錄的南韓選手金永範。港隊本屆游泳項目現有三面獎牌。
